name: OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycle_sgd_rate
type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ ε lower : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (n s : ℕ) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 < s →
          s ≤ n →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ)
                    f g σ →
                  LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k η => η k) ↑μ ↑P →
                    ∀ (K : ℕ),
                      8 * ↑n ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / (↑s * ε) + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                        (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleTree n s).IsMainBranch
                            OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch ∧
                          (∀ (k : ℕ),
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                (fun η =>
                                  ‖gradient f
                                        ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleTree n s).vertex
                                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleStep L σ ε n s) x0 g η
                                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                    2)
                                ↑P) ∧
                            1 / ↑K *
                                ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                  ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                    ‖gradient f
                                          ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleTree n s).vertex
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleStep L σ ε n s) x0 g η
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                      2 ∂↑P ≤
                              ε
